title.zh: 修订第1162号共和国法，将奎松市及其郊区纳入其适用范围的法案
title.en: An Act Amending Republic Act Numbered Eleven Hundred Sixty-Two so as to Include Quezon City and its Suburbs Within its Purview
title.orig: An Act Amending Republic Act Numbered Eleven Hundred Sixty-Two so as to Include Quezon City and its Suburbs Within its Purview

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1990_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Section one of Republic Act Numbered Eleven hundred sixty-two is amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 1. The expropriation of landed estates or haciendas in the City of Manila, Quezon City and its suburbs, which have been and are actually being leased to tenants, is hereby authorized."

Section two of the same Act is amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 2. Immediately upon the availability of the necessary funds by the Congress of the Philippines for the payment of just compensation for the said landed estates or haciendas, the Solicitor General shall institute the necessary expropriation proceedings before the competent court of the City of Manila or Quezon City, as the case may be."

The title of said Act is amended to read as follows:
"An Act providing for the expropriation of landed estates or haciendas or lands which formed part thereof in the City of Manila and Quezon, their subdivision into small lots, and the sale of such lots at cost or their lease on reasonable terms, and for other purposes."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1957
